answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit key-bound bond on the basalt ledger. Credits move only by transfers numbered by hop, and a terrace board lists tiers. A yarrow auditor recomputes each chain: the k-th transfer pays 15 credits and burns 2k credits, so the first burns 2 and the thousandth burns 2000. For 1000 fakes, bonds lock 60000, fees total 15000, and burns total 1001000. An honest identity makes one transfer, sinks 17, and recovers its 60. Splitting a chain to reset hops fails: a new chain needs a fresh bond and source credits, and the auditor links source keys and burns both bonds.
